title: AdaLoraTTBridge Benchmark Result Schema
description: Validates summary.json files produced by AdaLoRA↔TT bridge benchmark runs. See ADALORA_TT_BRIDGE_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md for the full protocol.

env_sha256.description: First 8 characters of SHA-256 of the accompanying env.json.

themisdb_git_sha.description: Full 40-character ThemisDB git commit SHA at time of run.

gate_status.description: BT-4 GGML bridge gate status. Must be 'cleared' for BT-4 results to be valid.

corpus_type.description: Whether adapter corpus is synthetically generated or from real fine-tuning runs.

measurements.description: Array of measurement records, one per experiment matrix cell.

experiment_id.description: Experiment identifier matching the protocol matrix (e.g., 'BT1-A-cold-r8').

cache_state.description: Cache state at measurement start (BT-1 only).

corpus_size.description: Number of adapters in the corpus (BT-2 only).

corpus_domain.description: Domain homogeneity of adapter corpus (BT-2 only).

n_runs.description: Number of independent repetitions. Must be >= 30 for validity_flags.n_runs_sufficient to be true.

latency_us.description: Latency statistics in microseconds (BT-1 and BT-4 only).

bytes_before.description: Total raw adapter weight bytes before deduplication (BT-2 only).

bytes_after.description: Total unique adapter weight bytes after deduplication (BT-2 only).

dedup_ratio.description: bytes_after / bytes_before; lower is better (BT-2 only).

dedup_hits.description: Number of layers whose TT-core fingerprint matched an existing entry (BT-2 only).

recon_error_mean.description: Mean relative Frobenius reconstruction error across layers (BT-3 only).

recon_error_max.description: Maximum relative Frobenius error (worst-case layer, BT-3 only).

rank_before.description: Total active rank summed across all layers before pruning (BT-3 only).

rank_after.description: Total active rank after pruning (BT-3 only).

downstream_accuracy_delta.description: Accuracy delta vs. unpruned baseline (BT-3-C only; null if skipped).

downstream_task.description: Downstream task name (BT-3-C only; null if skipped).

cohens_d.description: Cohen's d effect size vs. baseline (where applicable).

ci_95_low.description: 95% bootstrap CI lower bound for p50 (BT-1/BT-4).

ci_95_high.description: 95% bootstrap CI upper bound for p50 (BT-1/BT-4).

n_runs_sufficient.description: True iff n_runs >= 30 for all measurement cells.

cv_within_ceiling.description: True iff maximum CV across all latency cells is <= 15%.

cv_max_pct.description: Actual maximum CV (%) observed across all measurement cells.

warmup_protocol_followed.description: True iff the 3-phase warmup protocol (50/100/200 iterations) from MEASUREMENT_HYGIENE.md was applied.

bt4_gate_cleared.description: Must be true for BT-4 results to be considered valid. False for all other tracks.

corpus_type_declared.description: True iff corpus_type is set to 'synthetic' or 'real'.

env_descriptor_present.description: True iff env.json is present in the run directory.

notes.description: Free-text run notes, anomalies, or deviations from protocol.
